method: 25 separate actual image_gen.imagegen calls with person anchor, scene anchor, and one unmodified working candidate; frozen relative V2 prompt. All inputs inspected before calls. All output cards visually transcribed.
limitations: Model scores are recorded signals, not acceptance; all 25 working assets retain their earlier numeric FAIL.

Frozen V2 prompt requested a plain scorecard but did not explicitly demand a white background. Outputs vary between white and black backgrounds and include illustrations; no retries or prompt changes were made.
Semantic and blind runtime readability gates remain separate.
